desc: The MAX superconductor, the White Hole heating coil, White Hole glass and the White Hole frame box, all from White Hole Matter.

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}MAX Battery
desc: The MAX battery, built from White Hole Matter.

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}Riding the Rift
desc: Reality Diffraction's portal has 6 reserved cells for {9}GRB Receptor Ports{r}. Demand: 24 Bu/t (burst units per tick; 2.4e14 EU/t).
- {9}No port fitted{r}: the regions run at {times} 1 on their anchor fluids. No link is needed.

- {9}Ports fitted{r}: the regions ride the stream at {times} min({u+03c3}, 1.5); below {u+03c3} 0.5 no run starts and a running one pauses (nothing is voided). Fit ports only when you can feed them: a second quasar with its own mouths is the clean way.
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} your Reality Diffraction runs on a quasar link (tick the box).

quests.name: {6}{l}{n}The Endgame
desc: {9}Universium is not the end of the game.{r} It is where the pack's MHDCSM line begins: MHDCSM coats Eternity parts, builds Resplendent Components, and stands between you and the Stargate.
In Beyond the Stars the crafted Stargate waits here, past MAX. The pack's own Stargate quests follow in their own order, and {1}What, How?{r} is the end of the book.

[note]Universium comes with Eye T10 (coming later), so the pack's Universium line in this tab waits for it. The Supermassive Lattice quests here (L3, L4, Overdrive, Unbound) do not: they follow on from {c}The L2 Lattice{r} in Tier 14 - MAX.[/note]
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} you tick the box: this one is the chapter's introduction.

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}Saturation
desc: The quasar's last upgrade starts here. {9}Saturation{r}: a Quasar Engine at {9}4,096 SM on Magmatter (T4) Disc Field Coils{r}, its disc Stable or better ({9}|E| at most 40{r}) for {9}1 hour unbroken{r}. It is saved with the hole.

{5}{l}HOW{r} Run the disc at f 1.0 with the standard rig's trims and purges. An unattended disc at f 0.85 sits near E -16 and each eruption kicks it about 30 further, so the streak breaks at every eruption: Saturation needs a managed disc.

{5}{l}THEN{r} The {9}Supermassive Lattice{r} round the same quasar counts (the next quest). Until Saturation the GUI says "Reach Saturation first". A fully grown 4,096 SM quasar on its coils makes about {9}9,796 Bu/t{r} (9.8e16 EU/t, 98 quadrillion): that is {times}1 for the lattice's multipliers.

[note]Magmatter comes from the Godforge's magmatter mode, behind its EE upgrade. With Beyond the Stars' Eye, EE costs 8 Black Dwarf Matter frame boxes instead of 2 Universium ones, so Magmatter arrives with Eternity at Eye T7.[/note]
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} the quasar's GUI shows Saturation met (tick the box).

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}A Cage for a Galaxy
desc: The {9}Supermassive Lattice{r}: an armillary cage round the quasar you already have ({bomdims:quasar_lattice}). It is the same controller and the same hole, so nothing is lost.

{5}{l}THE CAGE{r} An equatorial ring and two latitude rings, tied to the quasar's cage by struts. The poles stay open, so jets, crowns and mouths dock as before. {bom:quasar_lattice:L} Lattice Frame Casings and {9}48 Containment Nodes{r}, all one tier, like coils. The hologram projector builds it on the 'lattice' channel, and NEI previews each tier.
{5}{l}THE TIERS{r} safe limit / top:
- {9}L1{r} Superdense Ergomatter and Magnetar Matter: 16,384 / 65,536 SM
- {9}L2{r} more of both, condensed: 65,536 / 262,144 SM
- {9}L3{r} more again, with Black Dwarf Matter: 262,144 / 4,194,304 SM, and Overdrive
- {9}L4{r} Constrained Eternity (Eternity and Magmatter plates): 4,194,304 / 67,108,864 SM, and Unbind

L1 nodes are an Assembly Line recipe: a Lattice Frame Casing, 4 UMV Field Generators, 4 any-UXV circuits, 2 dense Black Dwarf Matter plates, 8,000 L Superdense Ergomatter and 2,304 L Magnetar Matter. Each higher tier is made from a node of the tier below in the Condensate Assembler. To change tier, take the 48 old nodes out first: the projector does not replace nodes in place.

{5}{l}THE SETPOINT{r} With a lattice, growth stops at the {9}mass setpoint{r} (default: the safe limit; 4,096 SM up to the top), in the Supermassive Lattice panel. Lowering it below the mass sheds 2 % a second: the excess leaves up both jets, and the crowns make nothing while it does.
A missing lattice block under a hole over 4,096 SM freezes the quasar (nothing is lost) until the lattice is whole. To take a lattice down, set the setpoint to 4,096 SM first.
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} you hold 48 Containment Nodes L1 (HOLD {to} CLAIM {to} INSTALL).

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}Past the Coils
desc: Grow the hole to {9}16,384 SM{r}, the L1 safe limit: four times what any coil holds.

{5}{l}THE INTAKE{r} With a lattice, all the gas the rim hatches give in a second is the {9}intake{r}, up to {9}5{times} the Eddington feed{r}: per SM, 25 L/t of Hydrogen, 50 of Helium or 100 of Raw Stellar Plasma. The GUI's stacked bar spends it in order:
- {9}Disc{r} (white): f {times} Eddington, the only part that moves E;
- {9}Hold-up{r} (amber): 3 {times} x {times} Eddington, x your place in the band (0 at the safe limit, 1 at the top). It holds mass and grows nothing;
- {9}Growth{r} (green): the rest. It grows the hole with the same mass per litre as the disc.
So put in more gas than f draws. At the cap, with f 1 at a safe limit, the hole grows {9}5{times}{r} as fast as the disc alone.

{5}{l}POWER{r} Past 4,096 SM the output grows as the square root of mass: {9}{times}2 at 16,384 SM{r} (2.0e17 EU/t), {times}4 at 65,536 (3.9e17), {times}7.9 at 262,144 (7.7e17), then flattening toward {times}31 (3.0e18 EU/t) at the L4 top.
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} the GUI's mass bar reads 16,384 SM or more (tick the box).

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}Event Horizon Crown
desc: The crown's fourth structure tier, built round the same controller ({bomdims:crown_mk4}): cap {9}524,288 Bu/t{r} (5.2e18 EU/t, 5.2 quintillion), with {bom:crown_mk4:X} Event Horizon Thermaliser Casings.

{5}{l}HOW MANY{r} A Mk III caps at 8,192 Bu/t (8.2e16 EU/t), so a hole past 4,096 SM floods it. Two Mk IV (one per jet port) carry even full Overdrive's mean (979,600 Bu/t, 9.8e18 EU/t); four (two stacked on each port) also catch the eruption peaks. No hole ever needs more than four.

{5}{l}THE CONDUIT{r} The {9}Conduit Throat Mk IV{r} (assembly line, from a Mk III) carries 524,288 Bu/t (5.2e18 EU/t) through an element, on 2 L/s of Superdense Ergomatter (or 16 L/s Ergomatter, or 256 L/s Molten SpaceTime).
The EU still goes to your wireless network as one big number a second: no element can overflow.
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} a Mk IV crown is formed on a jet port (tick the box).

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}Pumping the Sky
desc: Feed the hole from {9}Space Elevator Pump modules{r} at {9}1,000,000 L/t or more for 1 hour{r}.

{5}{l}THE PUMPS{r} (GTNH-Intergalactic) Pump I: 313,600 L/t of Hydrogen (280,000 of Helium). Pump II: 1.25 M (1.12 M). {9}Pump III: 20.1 M L/t{r} of Hydrogen (17.9 M of Helium). A Space Elevator full of Pump III makes 4.8e8 L/t.
{5}{l}HOW MUCH{r} Hydrogen to hold the mass / at the 5{times} cap:
- 65,536 SM (the L1 top, the Eye gate): 1.31 M / 1.64 M L/t, {9}1 Pump III{r}
- 4,194,304 SM (the L3 top): 84 M / 105 M L/t, 5 Pump III
- 67,108,864 SM (the L4 top): 1.34 billion / 1.68 billion L/t, {9}67 Pump III{r}, about 3 full elevators
Helium needs twice the litres of Hydrogen, Raw Stellar Plasma four times. A fixed supply of Hydrogen holds the biggest hole; plenty of a heavier gas grows it faster.

{5}{l}INTO THE MACHINE{r} The 24 Rim Gas Injector sockets take ME Input Hatches (stocking) or plain ones. The controller draws every tick, at most 2,147,483,647 L a drain, and keeps a {9}60 s Accretion Buffer{r} of Disc + Hold-up. A YOTTank (GoodGenerator) or AE2FC cells hold the gas in bulk.
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} the intake has stayed at 1,000,000 L/t or more for an hour (tick the box).

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}Drinking Deep
desc: Run the intake at its {9}5{times} cap for 1 hour{r}: the hole drinks as fast as it can.

{5}{l}HOW FAST{r} At the cap with the feed f at 1.0, growth is 5{times} the disc's own at a safe limit and 2{times} at a band top, where the hold-up takes its share. From 4,096 SM on Helium at the cap:
- the Eye gate (65,536 SM on L1): {9}16.6 h{r}
- 4,194,304 SM on L4 (its safe limit): 32.8 h
- each Unbound doubling: 8.2 h
Hydrogen takes twice as long, Raw Stellar Plasma half.

{5}{l}UNDER-FED{r} An intake of F times the Eddington feed (F up to 5) holds the hole only up to band position (F - 1) / 3. Below 4{times} you cannot reach a band top, and the hole settles where your gas holds it. The line under the bar gives each segment's litres and the growth per hour.
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} the intake bar has sat on its 5{times} tick for an hour (tick the box).

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}Holding It Up
desc: Hold {9}65,536 SM on an L1 lattice for 1 hour{r}, with no leak: the top of the L1 band, and the hole the Eye's T9 {to} T10 Supermassive Link asks for.

{5}{l}OVER THE LIMIT{r} Mass over the safe limit has no time limit: the {9}hold-up gas{r} holds it. At a band top that is 3{times} Eddington on top of the disc, so at least {9}4{times} Eddington{r} of intake: 1.31 M L/t of Hydrogen, or 2.62 M of Helium, at 65,536 SM.

{5}{l}A LEAK{r} When the hold-up is short (the amber segment shows red), the extra mass leaks back: the part over the safe limit halves each hour on a log scale, never below the safe limit, and nothing is damaged. A dark disc holds nothing, so an outage leaks too; the 60 s Accretion Buffer covers a short one.

{5}{l}AUTOMATE{r} The Directive Hatch's Horizon set: [1] hold-up short, [2] buffer under 30 s, [4] anchor short, [8] Overdrive upkeep short. A Burst Control Hatch in Hold mode sets the setpoint (redstone 1 the safe limit .. 15 the band top; 0 leaves the GUI's setpoint, so an unwired hatch changes nothing). Sensor channels and OpenComputers (getHoldUp, getBuffer) report it.
Holding exactly 65,536 SM leaves no margin: keep the {9}Accretion Buffer{r} full (60 s), so a short supply gap never leaks the hole under the Supermassive Link's 65,536 SM.
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} the hole has held 65,536 SM for an hour with the hold-up fully paid, no leak (tick the box).

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}Supermassive Link
desc: The Eye's {9}T9 {to} T10 machine milestone{r}: link a hole of at least {9}65,536 SM{r} with a Supermassive Lattice (any tier) to the Eye through the conduit for {9}30 min unbroken{r}, with a 60 s mean of at least {9}96 Bu/t{r} (burst units per tick; 9.6e14 EU/t) on the Eye's ports. The streak resets when the link drops or the hole leaks under 65,536 SM.
It is met with an {9}L1 lattice{r} (Eye T8 products) and pack gases: nothing from Eye T9 or later.

Every stream already carries its source's lattice tier and mass. The Eye's GUI shows a {9}Supermassive Link{r} row (the streak, the mean, and whether the linked hole qualifies), OpenComputers getUnlock() has it, and the quasar's sensor has a Supermassive Link ready channel.

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}The L2 Lattice
desc: Remake the 48 nodes as {9}L2{r}: each L1 node plus 16,000 L Entangled Superdense Ergomatter, 4,608 L Entangled Magnetar Matter and 4 any-MAX circuits, in the Condensate Assembler at MAX. L2's safe limit is {9}65,536 SM{r} and its top 262,144 SM: the Eye gate's mass with no hold-up gas at all.

Take the 48 L1 nodes out before you place the L2 ones: the projector does not replace nodes in place. Over 4,096 SM the quasar freezes meanwhile, and nothing is lost; then let the projector place the new tier with the lattice channel set. L2 is not needed for the Eye gate, which is met on L1, but L3 and L4 are made from L2 nodes.
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} you hold 48 Containment Nodes L2 (HOLD {to} CLAIM {to} INSTALL).

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}A Universe to Hold It
desc: {9}L3{r}: each L2 node remade with 48,000 L Entangled Superdense Ergomatter, 9,216 L Entangled Magnetar Matter, 9,216 L Entangled Black Dwarf Matter and 4 any-MAX circuits (Condensate Assembler, MAX). Safe limit {9}262,144 SM{r}, top {9}4,194,304 SM{r}, and {9}Overdrive{r}.
At 262,144 SM a hole gives {9}{times}7.9{r} on gas alone (7.7e17 EU/t). A whole endgame base draws 1e16 to 1e17 EU/t: one L3 hole holds it several times over.

[note]Take the 48 L2 nodes out before you place the L3 ones: the projector does not replace nodes in place. Over 4,096 SM the quasar freezes meanwhile, and nothing is lost; then let the projector place the new tier with the lattice channel set.[/note]
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} you hold 48 Containment Nodes L3 (HOLD {to} CLAIM {to} INSTALL).

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}A Few Million
desc: Hold {9}2,097,152 SM or more for 1 hour{r}: "a few million stellar mass". On L3 that is band position 0.75, held by 3.25{times} Eddington of intake: about 34 M L/t of Hydrogen (1.7 Pump III), 52 M at the cap.
{5}{l}POWER{r} {times}19.5 on gas alone: {9}1.9e18 EU/t{r}. At the L3 top (4,194,304 SM), {times}24.2: 2.4e18 EU/t.
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} the GUI's mass bar has read 2,097,152 SM or more for an hour (tick the box).

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}Holding the Whole Base
desc: A {9}1 hour mean of at least 1e18 EU/t{r} (one quintillion, 100,000 Bu/t) with Overdrive off: from about 450,000 SM on L3 with a well-run disc, on gas alone.
Two Mk IV crowns carry it to your wireless network.
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} the quasar's Bursts row has averaged 1e18 EU/t for an hour with Overdrive off (tick the box).

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}Overdrive
desc: On an L3 lattice or better, {9}Overdrive{r} lifts the output toward a hard {9}{times}100{r} (9.8e18 EU/t, about 10 quintillion) for {9}100,000 {times} o{sq} L/s{r} each of Excited Stellar Plasma Mixture and Hyperdense Stellar Mixture, from the trim sockets or the rim gas sockets (ME stocking hatches work only in the gas sockets). o is 0 to 100 % in 5 % steps: the Supermassive Lattice panel, a Burst Control Hatch in Overdrive mode (o = s/15, rounded to 5 %), or OpenComputers setOverdrive.
{5}{l}RETURNS FALL{r} Half Overdrive gives 54 % (at 262,144 SM) to 78 % (at 4,194,304 SM) of the full gain. Upkeep each; output at 262,144 SM / 4,194,304 SM:

Running dry fades it over 1 s; nothing breaks. A dark disc makes nothing, Overdrive or not. Both fluids come from your Eye: Excited Stellar Plasma Mixture from Sirius A (T2), Hyperdense Stellar Mixture from the Kerr Compressor Module. At these rates, bank them ahead: Overdrive is for a while, not for always.
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} the GUI's output multiplier has read {times}50 or more for 10 minutes (tick the box).

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}Only for a Bit
desc: Run at {9}{times}90 or more for 10 minutes{r}. That takes a big hole and nearly full Overdrive: {times}91.4 at 4,194,304 SM with o 75 %, {times}96.3 at full.

Full Overdrive for 10 minutes burns {9}60 M L{r} each of Excited Stellar Plasma Mixture and Hyperdense Stellar Mixture; half for an hour, 90 M each. That is the "only for a bit": past {times}100 is never worth it, and the curve will not go there.
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} the output multiplier has read {times}90 or more for 10 minutes (tick the box).

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}Constrained Eternity
desc: {9}L4{r}, Constrained Eternity: each L3 node with 8 Eternity Plates, 8 Magmatter Plates, 16 any-MAX circuits, 144,000 L Entangled Superdense Ergomatter, 18,432 L Entangled Magnetar Matter and 2,880 L Entangled Eternity condensate (Condensate Assembler, MAX). Safe limit {9}4,194,304 SM{r}, top {9}67,108,864 SM{r}, and {9}Unbind{r}.

At the L4 top the hole gives {times}31 on gas alone: {9}3.0e18 EU/t{r}, held by 1.34 billion L/t of Hydrogen (67 Pump III). Take the 48 L3 nodes out before you place the L4 ones: the projector does not replace nodes in place. Over 4,096 SM the quasar freezes meanwhile, and nothing is lost; then let the projector place the new tier with the lattice channel set.
{2}{l}DONE WHEN{r} you hold 48 Containment Nodes L4 (HOLD {to} CLAIM {to} INSTALL).

quests.name: {4}{l}{n}Unbound
desc: On an L4 lattice, {9}Unbind{r} (click it twice in the Supermassive Lattice panel, as Bind and Shed also take two clicks, or OpenComputers setUnbound) lets the setpoint pass 67,108,864 SM. n = log2(M / 67,108,864) is the number of doublings past the top. Hold {9}n 1 or more for 1 hour{r} with the anchor paid.

{5}{l}THE ANCHOR{r} Every second the hole costs {9}1,024 {times} 4^(n{sq}) L{r} of Primordial Matter (GT's Transcendent Plasma Mixer), from the trim sockets or the rim gas sockets (ME stocking hatches work only in the gas sockets):
- n 3 (537 M SM): 2.7e8 L/s, impossible

Short of it, the hole {9}sheds safely{r} at 2 % a second to the doubling your supply pays for (with no Primordial Matter at all, back to the L4 top). Nothing is ever destroyed. The setpoint is kept: when the anchor is paid again, the hole grows back to it; lower the setpoint to stay where it is.

The Primordial Matter on hand caps the Unbound mass: with an ME stocking hatch that is the whole network's stock, so the hole grows until the anchor burns it faster than you refill it. Set the setpoint to the doubling your supply keeps up with.
Growth: one doubling per 8.2 h on Helium at the cap; the hold-up stays 3{times}. Unbound adds no power (the curve is flat): it makes Overdrive cheaper.
